units.source_text: 登山指南书上仅仅简单地记载着登山的路线、日程、客栈、费用等项目，反而使空想自由驰骋了。

en.t: The mountaineering guidebook listed only the route, schedule, inns, costs, and similar items in simple terms, which instead set his imagination roaming freely.

units.source_text: 岛村头一次认识驹子，是从积满残雪、抽出嫩芽的山上，走到这个温泉村来的时候。

en.t: Shimamura first came to know Komako when he walked down from the mountains, where lingering snow lay and new shoots were beginning to appear, into this hot-spring village.

units.source_text: 现在又逢秋天登山季节，在这里远望着留下自己足迹的山峦，心儿不由得被整个山色所吸引。

en.t: Now, with the autumn climbing season here again, he looked out from this place toward the mountains where he had left his own footprints, and his heart was drawn irresistibly to the whole mountain landscape.
